# Jira Story Markdown Format (V3)

The format the story-to-Jira sync tooling parses (the sync scripts themselves are not in this
kit; see the README's exclusions note). One file holds many stories; each story is
an `####` heading, stories are separated by `---`.

```markdown
#### Story Title [Category]
**Priority:** P0 -- Blocker | **Points:** 3 | **Sprint:** 1
**Dependencies:** ABC-7 (short description of why)

**As a** role, **I want** thing **so that** reason.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2

**Architecture Alignment:** how this fits the agreed architecture
**Risk Justification:** (optional) why the risk is acceptable
```

## How this relates to the four-section contract

A V3 story is an **intake** artifact: enough to file, prioritise, and sequence. Before the item
moves to Ready for agent execution, its description must be upgraded to the four-section
contract in `template-issue-work-item.md` (Outcome, Acceptance criteria, Scope, Explicitly out of
scope). The readiness filter in `/start-work-item` checks for those sections, and the two
enforcement skills bind to them; a raw V3 story is deliberately not ready.

## Parser rules (pre-flight validates all of these)

| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| Story headings are exactly four hashes (`####`) | Three or five hashes are read as prose, and the story is silently dropped |
| Title ends with `[Category]` in square brackets | The bracket contents become the Jira label |
| Acceptance criteria use `- [ ]` checkboxes | Plain bullets parse as description text, not criteria |
| Stories separated by `---` horizontal rules | Missing rules merge two stories into one |
| The `**As a** ... **I want** ... **so that** ...` line exists | Its absence is the most common cause of "stories not parsing" |
| No em dashes anywhere, except the priority literal (`P0 -- Blocker` through `P4 -- Trivial`) | House writing rule; also avoids encoding damage in the Jira round trip |

## Field mapping

| Markdown | Jira field | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Title | `summary` | |
| Priority `P0` to `P4` | `priority` | P0 = Highest, P1 = High, P2 = Medium, P3 = Low, P4 = Lowest |
| Points | Story points custom field | Configured per project; find the custom field id in Jira settings |
| `[Category]` | `labels` | Added hyphenated |
| Phase (from filename) | `labels` | Files named `Phase-<n>-...md` yield a `Phase-<n>` label |
| Sprint | `labels` | e.g. `Sprint-1` |
| User story + AC + dependencies | `description` | ADF for API v3, wiki markup for v2 |

## Legacy V1 format

Auto-detected, still parsed, do not write new files in it:

```markdown
**ABC-XX: Story Title**
- **Description:** ...
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - Criterion 1
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Priority:** High
- **Sprint:** 1
```
